messages.text: First site audit and GSC pull complete for phoenixmethodseo.com. April baseline: 90 impressions, 1 click, avg position 9.8, CTR 1.11%. Site is indexed and showing up in 25 keyword queries — strong early signal for a brand-new site. Top impressions: 'google business profile' (pos 2.4), 'google business profile optimization' (pos 8.5), 'conroe seo company' (pos 41 — opportunity to push into top 10). Target keywords like 'seo for therapists' and 'therapist seo services' aren't indexed yet — that's the content gap to close this month. One fix needed now: homepage meta description is 204 chars and getting cut off in SERPs — trim to under 165. Services page and case studies are next.

May data shows strong early traction. Impressions grew from 97 (April) to 652 — a 6.7x jump — as the service pages and canonicalization work from May settle into Google's index. The site now shows up for 73 distinct keyword queries, up from 35 in April. Average position is 73.7 (vs 10.0 in April) because the new keywords entering the index are in deep positions — expected for new content, will improve as pages build authority and we start pushing them with links. Top early signals: 'mental health seo' (51 impressions), 'behavioral health seo' (19 impressions), and 'ai citation optimization' (17 impressions). No agency keyword clicks yet but the footprint is growing. June priority: first blog post targeting 'seo for therapists', GBP listing, and FAQ page.

June was another strong growth month. Impressions climbed from ~700 in May to 1,701 in June — up 2.4x — and the site now surfaces for 93 distinct keyword queries (up from 73). Average position improved to 59.2 from 74.3 as Google gives the mental-health-seo hub and service pages more weight — the first time position has moved the right direction since launch. The mental-health cluster is now the clear strength: 'mental health seo' (175 impressions, pos 46.7), 'seo for mental health' (172, pos 48.5), and 'behavioral health seo' (116, pos 55.9) are all climbing toward page 3. On the delivery side, the first blog post — '5 Tips for Improving Website Rankings That Actually Move the Needle' — is published and fully optimized (PM-278), and title tags were shortened sitewide to render cleanly in search results (PM-128). Still no clicks yet, which is expected while everything sits in deep positions; the job now is to push the mental-health pages toward page 1 with more content and internal links. July priority: second blog post, Google Business Profile listing, and the FAQ page with schema.

August update. July was a consolidation month — the first blog post is live and indexed, title tags are trimmed sitewide, and the Phoenix AI content tool is deployed and operational. June's numbers held strong: 1,701 impressions across 93 keywords with average position improving to 59.2 from 74.3. The mental-health-seo keyword cluster is the clear growth engine — 'mental health seo' at pos 46.7 (175 impressions) and 'behavioral health seo' at pos 55.9 (116 impressions) are both climbing toward page 3. August priorities: second blog post targeting therapist SEO, Google Business Profile listing, FAQ page with schema, and beginning the case studies page using Lori and PHW results.
